title: Normalization of the actual PBC completed pullback compositor
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. All schemes $W$ below are noetherian and finite dimensional with $\ell$ invertible, with the meaning and the common full integral constructible categories of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. For finite $E\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $R_{E,W}=\lim_{n\geq1}(A_{E,n})_W$ on the small pro-etale site, and use framework and PBC completed pullbacks $F^s_{h,E},F^p_{h,E}$ of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Write $I_{W,E}$ for restriction along the quotient-normalized coefficient identity, giving the integral identity equivalence. All equalities below use these fixed identity transports; we suppress $I$ when source and target already have the same module presentation. For a scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$, let $G_{h,E}$ be ordinary derived module pullback on the completed rings. For a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ over $R_{E,T}$ set
$$Q_{h,E}(P)_n=\operatorname{Res}_n h_n^*(P\otimes_{R_{E,T}}(A_{E,n})_T),\qquad H(Q)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s_Q)[-1],$$
with the actual quotient transitions and $s_Q((x_n)_n)=(t_nx_{n+1})_n$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].
For each such tower, use the normalized derived comparison of [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison],
$$\rho_Q=[\iota_I]^{-1}[H(q)]:H(Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim Q,$$
where $q:Q\to I_\bullet$ is a K-injective tower resolution with injective terms and $\iota_I:\lim I_\bullet\to H(I_\bullet)$ has coordinates $z\mapsto(0,z)$. Write $b^{\rm amb}_{h,E}:IF^s_{h,E}\to F^p_{h,E}I$ for this comparison with the defining realization identifications, and $b^{\rm int}_{h,E}$ for its restriction to the full integral constructible categories.
Let $\kappa^s_{h,E}:G_{h,E}\to F^s_{h,E}$ be the specified quotient/zero-shifted-coordinate augmentation [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], and let $\kappa^p_{h,E}:G_{h,E}\to F^p_{h,E}$ be the actual PBC completion unit in this presentation. These satisfy $\kappa^p=b\kappa^s$. For composable isomorphisms $h:U\simeq V$, $k:V\simeq T$, write $c^G:G_{kh,E}\to G_{h,E}G_{k,E}$ for ordinary pullback composition. Let $c^s:F^s_{kh,E}\to F^s_{h,E}F^s_{k,E}$ be the specified whole-tower counit-normalized comparison [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], and let $c^p:F^p_{kh,E}\to F^p_{h,E}F^p_{k,E}$ be the actual PBC comparison, namely the adjunction conjugate of direct-image composition for the completion-induced adjunction [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate, lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction], transported from constant to completed coefficient sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Then
$$c^p\kappa^p_{kh}=(F^p_h\kappa^p_k)(\kappa^p_hG_k)c^G,\qquad
c^s\kappa^s_{kh}=(F^s_h\kappa^s_k)(\kappa^s_hG_k)c^G.$$
The first equation uses the actual adjunction units and counits, and its ordinary map is represented by the finite termwise $c_{h,k,n}$. On complete objects each specified $\kappa^s_h$ and $\kappa^p_h$ is invertible. The analogous actual identity maps $u^s:F^s_1\to1$ and $u^p:F^p_1\to1$ satisfy $u^s\kappa^s_1=u^G=u^p\kappa^p_1$, where $u^G:G_1\to1$ is ordinary identity pullback. In the unsuppressed presentations these normalizations give
$$u^p I\circ b^{\rm int}_1=Iu^s,$$
$$c^p I\circ b^{\rm int}_{kh}=(F^p_h b^{\rm int}_k)\circ(b^{\rm int}_hF^s_k)\circ(Ic^s).$$
No cancellation of an ambient completion unit on an incomplete object is asserted.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient rings only by their finite projections. Restriction from completed to constant coefficients identifies the finite-reduction towers, their transitions, total derived limits and completion units by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Exact countable products on these pro-etale module categories allow [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison] to apply to every Q in the statement. Its specified comparison is precisely [iota_I]^{-1}[H(q)]. The quotient augmentation has coordinates (0,(theta_n)_n), so that lemma sends it to the derived strict-augmentation map, not merely a map with the same finite projections. Consequently the realization identifications defining b carry the specified framework augmentation to the actual quotient-tower completion unit: kappa^p_h=b_h kappa^s_h. This proves this equality for arbitrary ambient inputs; it uses neither inversion nor cancellation of the augmentation.

proof.text: For a scheme isomorphism h, its inverse image is an exact equivalence and preserves inverse limits; its completed coefficient isomorphism is fixed by all finite projections [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. Thus ordinary module pullback G_h is this same equivalence, with the scalar action transported through that isomorphism. The whole-cone normalization [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-comparison-normalization] identifies the specified kappa^s_h with inverse image of the actual completion unit, followed by its specified cone identification, and asserts its invertibility on derived-complete inputs. Hence kappa^p_h=b_h kappa^s_h is invertible on those inputs as well. The reindexing identifications of [lem-pod-reindexing-completion-unit-tensor] preserve the actual reduction/limit unit and show that G_h carries complete objects to complete objects (equivalently, the site equivalence of [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image] (1), (2) transports the local completeness condition on every object and every section of the ideal). On the common full integral category all intermediate pullbacks remain constructible: apply [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback] and the common-category characterization [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization].

proof.text:
Apply [lem-per-quotient-completed-compositor-unit] with its g=k, h=h, B_W=R_{E,W}, P_h=G_h, gamma_h=kappa^p_h. Its hypotheses are exactly the noetherian finite-dimensional scheme and coefficient hypotheses here. It identifies the actual strict-tower pullback, its unit and its induced adjunction with completion followed by ordinary pullback, including constant-coefficient transport. In its notation a=(c^G)^{-1} and hat a=(c^p)^{-1}; its conjugate is for the same direct-image composition and the same induced Hom bijections, not an arbitrarily chosen compositor. Its displayed equation therefore gives
(c^p)^{-1} kappa^p_h(F^p_k K) G_h(kappa^p_k(K))=kappa^p_{kh}(K)(c^G)^{-1}.
Compose on the left with c^p and on the right with c^G. Naturality of kappa^p_h at kappa^p_k(K) gives
c^p kappa^p_{kh}=(F^p_h kappa^p_k)(kappa^p_h G_k)c^G.
Its identity equation gives u^p kappa^p_1=u^G at once. No completion unit was cancelled in deriving either equality.

proof.text: The ordinary c^G just used has the required finite representative. Indeed [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image] identifies all coefficient maps with the maps induced by constant sections and quotient projections, including their compatibility with ring homomorphisms. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] to the completed coefficient sheaves and to each finite quotient. It computes composition on one flat-term K-flat complex by the termwise module-pullback compositor. Reducing that compositor sends the same tensor generator (h^{-1}k^{-1}p) tensor 1 to the twice-pulled generator with scalar 1. It is therefore c_{h,k,n} at every n and commutes with the actual quotient transitions. The ordinary composition a of [lem-per-quotient-completed-compositor-unit] is the canonical comparison of [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons] (inverted), which that statement computes by the same termwise module-pullback composition on K-flat complexes with flat terms; both are classes of one chain map on one representative, so a=(c^G)^{-1}. This identifies the ordinary map used in step 3, without postulating a different ordinary comparison.

source.place: Tag 0D6D, lemma-derived-pullback-composition, proof on flat-term K-flat complexes

proof.text:
For the framework equation, retain the entire-system counit in the specified eta of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Write R for simultaneous reduction, L for realization and e:R L -> 1 for its specified counit. The adjunction of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] gives the identity e_{R K} R(u_K)=1_{R K} in the derived system category. For Q_k=U_k R K, compose the arrow R F^s_k K -> Q_k used to define eta with the reduction of kappa^s_k. Under the reindexing identifications of [lem-pod-reindexing-completion-unit-tensor], this is U_k(e_{R K} R(u_K))=1_{Q_k}. In particular this is an equality of entire derived quotient diagrams. Apply U_h and L: by the defining counit construction of eta this says
eta_{h,k} (F^s_h kappa^s_k)(kappa^s_h G_k)=L(d_{h,k}) a_{h,k},
where a_{h,k}:G_hG_k K -> L(R(G_hG_k K)) is the quotient augmentation and d_{h,k}:R(G_hG_k K) -> Q_{h,k} is the projection-normalized reduction identification. Both coordinates of its Roos presentation are fixed: the shifted coordinate is zero and the nth unshifted coordinate is twice-pulled quotient reduction. The termwise equality from step 4 gives L(c_{h,k,bullet}) kappa^s_{kh}=L(d_{h,k}) a_{h,k} c^G. Substitute c^s=eta_{h,k}^{-1} L(c_{h,k,bullet}) to obtain the required framework equation. This uses the adjunction triangle on whole systems, not faithfulness of finite evaluations.

proof.text: For the identity isomorphism the same system triangle reads e_{R K} R(u_K)=1_{R K}, with no reindexing and with the coefficient action unitor. The analogous identity construction in [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] therefore carries the quotient augmentation to the ordinary identity map: u^s kappa^s_1=u^G. Its Roos map is again (0,quotient), as fixed by [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Together with step 3 this proves both identity normalizations for the specified maps.

source.place: Tag 099N, lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case; agent assembly with the specified normalized whole-tower comparisons

proof.text:
Work now on a complete integral object K and suppress the identity coefficient transports. Precompose the desired compositor equality with the invertible kappa^s_{kh}(K) from step 2. Its left side becomes c^p kappa^p_{kh}. By step 3 this equals F^p_h(kappa^p_k) kappa^p_h(G_k K)c^G. On its right side, step 5 and naturality of b_h give
F^p_h(b_k) b_h(F^s_k K) F^s_h(kappa^s_k) kappa^s_h(G_k K)c^G
=F^p_h(b_k) F^p_h(kappa^s_k) b_h(G_k K) kappa^s_h(G_k K)c^G
=F^p_h(kappa^p_k) kappa^p_h(G_k K)c^G.
Here b is natural because rho and the defining realization identifications are natural [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. Cancellation of kappa^s_{kh}(K) proves the compositor equality. Likewise precomposing u^p b_1=u^s with invertible kappa^s_1 reduces it to the two identity normalizations. Restoring I gives exactly the two unsuppressed equations in the statement. Fullness of the common integral subcategories lets these ambient equalities restrict to b^{int}; no equality or cancellation on an incomplete object was used.

I read all 7 steps against every cited statement. Step 1: the Roos lemma's zero-shifted augmentation normalization plus def-weil-inverse-image (b) θ̃=(0,θ) and the def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback unit give κ^p=bκ^s with no cancellation. Step 2: lem-weil-isomorphism-normalization (θκ=G(u), κ invertible on complete inputs) and the constructibility of isomorphism pullback check out. Step 3: lem-per-quotient-completed-compositor-unit with g=k, h=h, γ=κ^p, â=(c^p)^{-1} via (τ^{-1})^c=(τ^c)^{-1}; I recomputed the naturality step. Step 5: the e_{RK}R(u_K)=1 triangle is a whole-system identity; η·F_h(κ_k)·κ_h(G_k)=L(d)a, and both sides of the step-4 equation are zero-shifted augmentations, so the Roos lemma equates them. Step 7: I recomputed the naturality chain; cancellation is only on complete K. Edge cases checked: identities, the zero object, incomplete K. FIX (one fault, C3/C4-type): step 3 asserted a=(c^G)^{-1}, but lem-per's a is the compositor of lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons, which was not cited. Step 4 now cites lem-sfb (whose statement computes that compositor by termwise K-flat pullback composition) and states the identification; lem-sfb was added to proof_deps and tool_uses (no cycle). Step 2 also gained a parenthetical: completeness is preserved via the site equivalence of lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image (1),(2). Batch 5: lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-comparison-normalization (sk-thm-trace-transport) and lem-pod-reindexing-completion-unit-tensor (sk-def-weil) are generic coefficient comparisons for scheme isomorphisms; their closures reach no trace-formula or Poincaré-duality theorem and no nt-assume leaf, so I accepted both as tools.
